text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Up and to the left is better. Each panel has its own axes; the line joins mixture's two operating points.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Primary seed 42; learned arms at both thresholds. Output tokens include both answer-extraction passes and exclude input processing and the teacher-forcing feature pass.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: In-domain Omni-MATH heads are fitted on Omni-MATH; transfer panels apply each model's saved MATH policy to the same Omni test responses.
